paragraphs: In the morning, align with business teams on pain points and translate high inventory and low on-time performance into constraints and objectives. At midday, run models and tune parameters to compare trade-offs across several solutions. In the afternoon, prepare a visual report and explain to managers why a particular schedule costs the least. After implementation, monitor metrics and revise the model.

subject.summary: An operations research analyst is someone who uses models and mathematics to calculate optimal solutions for organizations. Capacity, inventory, scheduling, and routing ultimately become a plan that delivers real financial savings.
